{{Top|leg}}
The '''Planetary Tariff Code''' regulated imports to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]]. Alternative Minimum Tax, Article 7, section C, paragraph 3, subsection 4 stated that "no native grown protected or subsidized plants may be imported without being subject to a minimum tax no less that 500% of current retail selling price."
